entities.name: Joseph Trinh Chinh Truc
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Trịnh Chính Trực was the Catholic bishop of the Diocese of Ban Mê Thuôt, Vietnam. Ordained to the priesthood in 1954, Truc was named bishop in 1981, and retired in 2000.
